canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Wells Fargo Bank Na denied {value} of its 2,525 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Wells Fargo Bank Na decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Wells Fargo Bank Na will deny any specific future application with 48.6% probability
Wells Fargo Bank Na is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Wells Fargo Bank Na discriminates or violates law
48.6% applies to Wells Fargo Bank Na's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
